SELECT t.device_id,
    t.recorded_at,
    t.device_uptime_s,
    t.source,
    t.fix,
        CASE
            WHEN t.lat_sealed IS NULL THEN t.lat
            ELSE (jsonb_populate_record(NULL::location_records, jsonb_build_object('lat', gps_open_cell(t.lat_sealed, gps_cell_context('location_records'::text, jsonb_build_object('device_id', to_jsonb(t.device_id), 'recorded_at', to_jsonb(t.recorded_at), 'source', to_jsonb(t.source)), '{device_id,recorded_at,source}'::text[], 'lat'::text))))).lat
        END AS lat,
        CASE
            WHEN t.lng_sealed IS NULL THEN t.lng
            ELSE (jsonb_populate_record(NULL::location_records, jsonb_build_object('lng', gps_open_cell(t.lng_sealed, gps_cell_context('location_records'::text, jsonb_build_object('device_id', to_jsonb(t.device_id), 'recorded_at', to_jsonb(t.recorded_at), 'source', to_jsonb(t.source)), '{device_id,recorded_at,source}'::text[], 'lng'::text))))).lng
        END AS lng,
    t.sat,
    t.ttff_s,
    t.csq,
    t.reg,
    t.vbat_mv,
        CASE
            WHEN t.raw_sealed IS NULL THEN t.raw
            ELSE (jsonb_populate_record(NULL::location_records, jsonb_build_object('raw', gps_open_cell(t.raw_sealed, gps_cell_context('location_records'::text, jsonb_build_object('device_id', to_jsonb(t.device_id), 'recorded_at', to_jsonb(t.recorded_at), 'source', to_jsonb(t.source)), '{device_id,recorded_at,source}'::text[], 'raw'::text))))).raw
        END AS raw,
    t.user_id,
    t.heading,
        CASE
            WHEN t.fixes_jsonb_sealed IS NULL THEN t.fixes_jsonb
            ELSE (jsonb_populate_record(NULL::location_records, jsonb_build_object('fixes_jsonb', gps_open_cell(t.fixes_jsonb_sealed, gps_cell_context('location_records'::text, jsonb_build_object('device_id', to_jsonb(t.device_id), 'recorded_at', to_jsonb(t.recorded_at), 'source', to_jsonb(t.source)), '{device_id,recorded_at,source}'::text[], 'fixes_jsonb'::text))))).fixes_jsonb
        END AS fixes_jsonb,
    t.speed_kmh
   FROM location_records t;
